resources.string: Pause Mika
Stop all of Mika’s work until you resume
Paused: no tasks or plans run
On

Pausing stops every running and queued task, skips plans that come due, and turns away new tasks from chat, computers and message channels until you resume. It also turns off Mika’s accessibility service and wireless debugging and stops the phone helper. Nothing is uninstalled or deleted, and the wireless-debugging pairing stays saved.
